snippet.title: अक्टूबर के अंत में चक्रवाती तूफान की आशंका, बारिश और बदलते मौसम पर किसानों को अलर्ट
snippet.description:
किसान तक के मौसम पूर्वानुमान में अक्टूबर महीने के दूसरे पखवाड़े के मौसम और संभावित बदलावों की विस्तृत जानकारी दी गई है। इस दौरान दक्षिण भारत में उत्तर-पूर्वी मानसून के आगमन के साथ चक्रवात का मौसम भी शुरू हो रहा है। बंगाल की खाड़ी और अरब सागर दोनों क्षेत्रों में 25 अक्टूबर के आसपास मौसमी सिस्टम मजबूत होने से चक्रवाती तूफान बनने की संभावना जताई गई है। दूसरी तरफ उत्तर भारत के कई राज्यों में अधिकतम तापमान सामान्य से ऊपर बना हुआ है, हालांकि उत्तर की हवाओं के चलने से रात और सुबह के समय ठंडक महसूस होने लगी है। मध्य प्रदेश, राजस्थान और दक्षिण-पश्चिमी उत्तर प्रदेश के कुछ हिस्सों में हल्की वर्षा के आसार हैं, जबकि दक्षिण प्रायद्वीपीय भारत और महाराष्ट्र के कुछ क्षेत्रों में अच्छी बारिश की संभावना है। ऐसे में किसानों को सलाह दी गई है कि फसलों की कटाई और मड़ाई का काम जल्द पूरा करें तथा कटी हुई फसलों को मंडियों या खलिहानों में खुले में रखने से बचें ताकि नुकसान न हो।

snippet.title: My child doesn't like blanket, he keeps kicking the blanket,  Doesn't he feel cold? #blanket #baby
snippet.description:
How much ever cold it is,  My kid doesn't like to keep the blanket on.

I cover him and he removes it all the time.

Why? Why do they keep kicking the blanket??

Three main reasons for this.

1.) Metabolism.

Kids have much higher metabolism compared to adults.

Their bodies are much warmer than us, what feels like cold to us is not for them.

Once the AC is on, we cover ourselves in blankets. But for kids, it feels like an oven.

2.) REM sleep. 

Adults have more NREM, sleep and kids have more REM sleep.

So they keep moving during their sleep.

3.) Safety mechanism.

The risks of asphyxiation and overheating from blankets are real.

Kids have this natural mechanism of kicking the blanket to save themselves.

Just leave him alone when he's grown up. He'll have the blanket again.

What should parents do?

1.) Always dress them in full pants and full hands to protect from cold.

2.) Eliminate all mosquitoes from room and use a mosquito net. 

3.) Leave the kid alone when he kicks the blanket.

How to avoid mosquito bites in babies? and how to treat them when they have each to know about this.

snippet.title: Nobody Controls This Music. Not Even The Artist #shorts #art
snippet.description: The Clinamen by Céleste Boursier-Mougenot turns floating white porcelain bowls into an unpredictable musical experience. As the bowls drift across a pool of blue water, they collide and produce delicate sounds that can never be perfectly repeated. Inspired by the ancient philosophical idea of atoms making unexpected movements, the installation explores how chance can create something beautiful without anyone controlling the outcome. The artwork reminds us that life doesn't always follow a plan, and sometimes the smallest, most unexpected changes can lead us somewhere completely different. Not everything beautiful needs to be controlled. #contemporaryart #modernart

snippet.title: These rubber covers make walking in ski boots safe.
snippet.description:
Modern alpine ski boots are engineering marvels designed strictly for locking securely into bindings and transferring power to the skis. To achieve this rigid energy transfer, the thick soles are manufactured from extremely hard plastics like polyurethane. While this inflexible foundation is perfect for carving down a snowy mountain, it becomes a severe physical hazard the moment a skier steps onto the slick concrete floors of a winter resort lodge.

The smooth plastic base completely lacks the pliable friction necessary to safely grip hard manufactured surfaces. To mitigate this dangerous loss of traction, winter athletes utilize specialized slip on rubber covers that stretch directly over the bottom of the footwear. These durable vulcanized attachments temporarily modify the physical geometry of the boot. The heavy rubber tread instantly creates a high friction contact patch that bends and conforms to the microscopic imperfections found in asphalt and wet tile.

By changing the material properties of the sole, these simple protective layers completely alter the biomechanics of walking in heavy winter gear. The flexible rubber absorbs the harsh kinetic impact of each footstep while preventing dangerous slips in icy parking lots. This removable barrier also shields the expensive plastic heel and toe lugs from abrasive concrete damage, ensuring the boots will still engage safely with the ski bindings on the mountain.

snippet.title: ¡TRUDY YA ES CATEGORÍA 3! Alertan por lluvias extremas en el Pacífico mexicano
snippet.description:
El huracán Trudy alcanzó la categoría 3 durante la madrugada de este viernes 16 de octubre de 2026, con vientos sostenidos de 195 km/h y rachas de hasta 240 km/h. A las 6:30 de la mañana, el sistema se ubicaba a 385 kilómetros al suroeste de Acapulco, Guerrero, y avanzaba hacia el noroeste a 9 km/h. 
Las autoridades mantienen vigilancia en las costas del Pacífico ante la posibilidad de que Trudy continúe intensificándose. Se pronostican lluvias intensas en Guerrero y Oaxaca, precipitaciones muy fuertes en Michoacán y oleaje de hasta cinco metros en algunas zonas costeras. 
Además, Guerrero anunció la suspensión de clases como medida preventiva. Conoce la trayectoria reportada, los estados bajo vigilancia y las recomendaciones para evitar inundaciones, deslaves y otros riesgos asociados con el huracán.
